name: Klaudia Guzij
headline: Building Agents @ Sierra

summary:
Started my career in sales & consulting at IBM before diving into the startup world, where I learned the ins and outs of sales, product, and design across multiple industries. Spent the last 3 years in the growth & product function at Kyte, scaling from Series A to Series C, before venturing out to ideate on AI agent startups and helping an early-stage mobility startup go from 0 to 1. 

Recently joined Coval to build out GTM, product & customer success.
